# Storage

How bytes are kept, addressed and never overwritten. Blobs, guids, the
refusal to reuse a name, and what a stored file is addressed by.

## Immutability

Why a source is written once and never edited, and what that costs.

## Addressing

Getting from a document to its bytes, and why no rule turns a filename into
a path.

# Time

Clocks, ordering, replay, and every place this project has declined to build
a semantic clock.

## Replay

Reconstructing a past state from records, and why the capability kept
surviving every cut.

# Measurement

Counting things before deciding them. Denominators, corpus sizes, and the
habit of writing a five-line script before taking a position.
